notes.title: Minor Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
We’ve added new features and made some improvements.

[h2]Dictionary[/h2]

You can now check information about the cards you’ve acquired during gameplay from the title screen.

[h2]Image Update for Event Trials
[/h2]
The two question mark images have been replaced with key icons.

We hope they become the key to unlocking the true ending.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where using the “Fated Harmony” card caused the game to stop. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the end-turn button did not appear when starting a new game after the final trial.
[*] Fixed an issue where the achievement “Guardian of Perfect Balance” could not be unlocked.
If you’ve unlocked all other achievements except for this one, you can unlock it by downloading the updated version, starting a new game, and viewing the map for the first time.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Balantica development team Hanzan.

Since the release of the game, we have been sincerely reading all the reviews and watching the videos shared by our players. We are deeply grateful for your support.

The first major patch after the release includes the following updates:

[h2]Boss Stage Added[/h2]
    
You can now encounter the devil and take on the final trial upon reaching the altar!  
Be sure to check out the true ending after completing the final trial.
    
(New achievements have been added along with the addition of the boss stage.)
    
[h2]Update[/h2]
    
[list]
[*] The issue where the game would not progress after selecting an event has been resolved.    
[*] You can now close panels using the ESC key, and if no panel is open, the settings panel will be activated instead.
[/list]
    
 Sincerely,
 Team Hanzan.

tags.bug: The issue where the game would not progress after selecting an event has been resolved.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Updates[/b]

- The color of the "Legendary Card Acquisition" button after clearing a trial event has been changed to gold.
- The panel image displaying the rules for trials has been replaced.
- A typo in the cactus event has been fixed. (English)
- Branch nodes have been added between regions for ending variations. [i](The endings and boss stage are still under development. Currently, only the normal ending is available.)[/i]
- Node hidden by clouds have been removed.
- The text for the normal ending has been updated.

[b]New Features[/b]

- A help panel detailing the game rules has been added. A button to open the help panel is now located next to the settings button.
- A glowing effect has been added to belongings when their effects activate.
- The amount of Hope gained through cards and Courage effects is now displayed above the character portraits.
- A sound effect has been added for when stones disappear.
- A motion effect has been added to the button for acquiring cards after a trial ends.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- New Endings.

- Card and Belonging Compendium.
- Display for Remaining Activations: Shows how many uses are left for belongings and certain trial rules.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
A small update that fixes some bugs and new features

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Tiny Hope: Fixed a bug where the trial effect was not displayed on the card.

[b]New Features[/b]

- Stone Effects: Added effects to stones that will disappear due to Suspended Status or trial rules. Stones that are set to disappear now display a white translucent effect.
- Belongings: Updated the images for Belongings.
- New Achievement: Added a new achievement, "You Only Need Draw."

[b]Additional Notes[/b]

- The boss stage is currently in development! It will be included in next week's update, along with changes to the ending. Please stay tuned a little longer!
